label: C* for caused movers from the operation route (inference)
rule: Operation potency, actualized by acting, is being moved (Physics III.1); the operation respect is relevant
meaning: New non-transcription conditional derivation (the unified derivation of docs/notes/caused-mover-cstar.md, section 2). Let y, whose being another causes, move x in r. By 631e014f the moving is an operation in a respect o in which y is in potency; by d791628f acting actualizes that potency as such; by the Physics III.1 analysis 0628359b y is being moved in o; by 7bf380c6 o is relevant to the moving. The hypothesis that y is moved in some respect is not used. The relevance enters only through 7bf380c6; without it the first three premises give only that y is being moved in some respect (the content of 777646a5). 631e014f carries the passage from the CAUSE_2 guard to CAUSE_1 moving. Under POTENCY_1, 631e014f fails for steady exercise of a retained power (section 3), so this route does not reach the retained-state movers. All premises stay OPEN. No premise is established.
